abstract: We use a newly constructed narrative measure of regulatory bank capital requirement tightening events (Eickmeier et al., 2023) to examine their effects on household income and expenditure inequality in the US. Income and expenditure inequality both decline (the latter decline being slightly less pronounced than the former). Financial income strongly drops after the regulatory events. Richer households tend to be more exposed to financial markets. Hence, their income and expenditures decline by more than those of poorer households. The monetary policy easing after the regulation is shown to contribute to the decline in inequality at longer horizons, as it cushions the negative effects of the capital requirement tightenings on wages and salaries in the medium run, which represent a considerable share of income for lower- to middle-income households.
abstract_zh: 我们利用新构建的叙事性银行资本监管要求收紧事件指标（Eickmeier等，2023），研究其对美国居民家庭收入与支出不平等的影响。研究发现，收入不平等与支出不平等均有所下降（后者降幅略小于前者）。监管事件发生后，金融收入显著下降。富裕家庭通常更易受金融市场波动影响，因此其收入与支出的降幅大于贫困家庭。研究表明，监管实施后的宽松货币政策在长期内有助于降低不平等程度——该政策在中长期缓冲了资本要求收紧对工资薪金的负面冲击，而工资薪金在中低收入家庭收入中占据相当比重。
authors: Sandra Eickmeier; Benedikt Kolb; Esteban Prieto
title: Effects of Bank Capital Requirement Tightenings on Inequality
title_zh: 银行资本要求收紧对不平等的影响

abstract: Firms and policy makers are increasingly looking at friend-shoring to make supply chains less vulnerable to geopolitical tensions. We test whether these considerations are shaping FDI flows, using investment-level data on almost 300,000 instances of greenfield FDI between 2003 and 2022. Estimates from a gravity model, which controls for standard push and pull factors, show an economically significant role for geopolitical alignment in driving the geographical footprint of bilateral investments. This result is robust to the inclusion of standard bilateral drivers of FDI—such as geographic distance and trade flows—and the strength of the effect has increased since 2018, with the resurgence of trade tensions between the U.S. and China. Moreover, our results are not limited to greenfield FDI, but hold also for M&As.
abstract_zh: 企业和政策制定者日益关注"友岸外包"，以降低供应链受地缘政治紧张局势影响的风险。我们利用2003年至2022年间近30万例绿地外商直接投资的项目层面数据，检验这些考量是否正在影响外商直接投资的流动。基于引力模型的估计（该模型控制了标准的推拉因素）表明，地缘政治一致性在驱动双边投资的地理布局中发挥着具有经济显著性的作用。这一结果在纳入标准双边外商直接投资驱动因素（如地理距离和贸易流动）后依然稳健，且自2018年美中贸易紧张局势再度升级以来，该效应的强度有所增强。此外，我们的结论不仅适用于绿地外商直接投资，对并购活动同样成立。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要仅出现一次中国相关表述，需确认中国是否为核心研究对象
title: Investing in Friends: The Role of Geopolitical Alignment in FDI Flows
title_zh: 投资于朋友：地缘政治联盟在外国直接投资流动中的作用

abstract: We propose a Bayesian VAR model with stochastic volatility and time varying skewness to estimate the degree of labour at risk in the euro area and in the United States. We model the asymmetry of the shocks to changes in the unemployment rate as a function of real activity and financial risk factors. We find that the conditional distribution of the changes in the unemployment rate displays time-varying volatility and skewness, with peaks coinciding with the Global Financial Crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic. We take advantage of the multivariate nature of our parametric model to measure stagflation risk defined as the possible joint event of large increases in the unemployment rate and large annual rates of inflation. We find an increasing risk of stagflation for the euro area in 2022 while in the United States stagflation risk increased earlier in 2021 and started decreasing more recently. Notwithstanding the significantly high levels of inflation, stagflation risks have been contained by the resilient performance of the labour market in both areas. Labour at risk is therefore important for the assessment of the inflation-unemployment trade-off.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一个包含随机波动和时变偏度的贝叶斯向量自回归模型，用于估计欧元区和美国的劳动风险程度。我们将失业率变化冲击的非对称性建模为实际经济活动与金融风险因素的函数。研究发现，失业率变化的条件分布呈现时变波动性和偏度特征，其峰值与全球金融危机和新冠疫情时期相吻合。我们利用参数模型的多元特性，将滞胀风险定义为失业率大幅上升与年通胀率高企可能同时发生的联合事件。测算结果显示，欧元区滞胀风险在2022年持续攀升，而美国滞胀风险则更早于2021年上升，近期已开始回落。尽管通胀水平显著高企，但两大经济体的劳动力市场韧性表现有效抑制了滞胀风险。因此，劳动风险对于评估通胀-失业权衡关系具有重要参考价值。
title: Labour at risk
